decisions.boundary_condition: Do not generalize this to other amenities such as microwave, balcony, bar, fireplace, room size, location, dates, or price.
decisions.canonical_value: Prefers hotel rooms with both an in-room coffee maker and a refrigerator or mini-fridge.
decisions.condition: When selecting or comparing hotel rooms and in-room amenities are being considered.
decisions.default_action: Use an in-room coffee maker and refrigerator or mini-fridge as soft amenity criteria, and confirm availability when relevant.
decisions.exception_condition: If a hotel otherwise strongly matches the current trip, treat a missing coffee maker or refrigerator/mini-fridge as a point to confirm with the user rather than an automatic rejection.
decisions.name: hotel_room_coffee_maker_and_fridge_preference
decisions.preference_value: Prefers a hotel room with both a coffee maker and a refrigerator or mini-fridge.
decisions.rationale: Repeated evidence across hotel conversations supports a reusable soft preference for rooms with both a coffee maker and refrigerator/mini-fridge. It is not a hard requirement and should not be generalized to unrelated amenities.

decisions.boundary_condition: Treat this as a soft default unless the user explicitly makes breakfast mandatory. Do not infer a required breakfast quality standard from this preference alone.
decisions.canonical_value: Prefers hotels that include free breakfast.
decisions.condition: When searching for or comparing hotels for an overnight trip, after satisfying explicit core constraints such as location, room or bed needs, budget, and required hotel class.
decisions.default_action: Rank or surface hotels with free breakfast higher, and confirm whether a candidate includes it when the amenity is not clear.
decisions.exception_condition: Relax or ignore this preference if the user says breakfast is unimportant, if no suitable hotel meets higher-priority constraints with free breakfast, or if the user knowingly chooses a hotel without it.
decisions.name: prefer_hotels_with_included_breakfast
decisions.preference_value: Prefer a hotel that includes free breakfast.
decisions.rationale: Multiple hotel examples show interest in included breakfast. The evidence supports a reusable preference, but wording varies in strength, so it should remain a soft default rather than a mandatory filter or a claim about breakfast quality.
